usage.callShape: POST https://cron.memoryapi.org/x402/cron/register with JSON body {agent_id, interval_minutes, url, ...}
usage.outputShape: On success expected body with job id; on validation failure body.error is a string naming the next missing required field (e.g. body.error = \"agent_id is required\")
quirks: inputSchema was null in registry — required fields discovered empirically via 400 errors
Required fields validated ONE AT A TIME: first 'agent_id is required', then 'interval_minutes is required' — you cannot see all requirements up front
Schedule is INTERVAL-BASED via integer 'interval_minutes', NOT a cron expression string (a 'schedule':'0 0 * * *' field was ignored/insufficient)
CHARGE-ON-VALIDATION-FAILURE: each 400 still costs $0.05 — every malformed attempt is billed. Build the full body before calling to avoid burning USDC on schema discovery
QA hit the 2-paid-attempt ceiling at agent_id+interval_minutes stage; a fully-valid 2xx body was not directly confirmed but the field progression makes the required set clear
usage.guide: Register a recurring agent cron job by POSTing JSON to https://cron.memoryapi.org/x402/cron/register and paying $0.05 USDC on Base via x402. The body MUST include agent_id (your agent identifier) and interval_minutes (integer minutes between runs — this is interval-based, not a cron expression), plus the target url to call. Send all known fields in ONE request: the server validates required fields sequentially and bills $0.05 on EVERY attempt including validation-failure 400s, so do not probe the schema field-by-field. Read the created job id from the success response body.
